meta.title: Giulia Cardarilli | Psychology
meta.description: Professional portfolio of Giulia Cardarilli, a psychologist in clinical training.

hero.title: Understanding our bonds is also a way of caring for ourselves.
hero.description: I am Giulia Cardarilli, a psychologist in clinical training, interested in attachment, relationships and emotional wellbeing.

about.title: A thoughtful, rigorous and human perspective.
about.paragraphOne: My professional interest is rooted in listening and in understanding the experiences that shape the way we relate to one another.
about.paragraphTwo: I combine my background in Psychology with experience in high-responsibility settings, analysis and people-facing work. I value empathy, confidentiality and a careful approach to each individual reality.

experience.title: Skills that complement my professional profile.
experience.intro: A career developed in demanding environments, with particular attention to people, responsible communication and the careful analysis of information.
experience.amlDescription: Experience in the responsible analysis of sensitive information, rigorous process management and decision-making in a high-demand environment.
experience.managerDescription: Supporting people in an international context through clear, approachable communication adapted to diverse needs.
experience.profileDescription: Coordination, internal training and teamwork have strengthened a proactive, organised way of working that is attentive to individual needs.

education.title: Continuous learning.
education.masterDescription: Advanced training to broaden knowledge and skills within the field of clinical psychology.
education.attachmentTitle: Adult Attachment: From Our Bonds to Our Relationships
education.attachmentDescription: Training focused on understanding adult attachment and its influence on the way we build and experience relationships.

contact.title: Let's start a conversation.
contact.description: For collaborations, projects or professional enquiries, you can find me on LinkedIn.

footer.disclaimer: This website presents a professional and educational profile. It does not offer psychological care or constitute a clinical practice.
